fee_notes: Royalties are 6% of Gross Sales, withdrawn weekly via pre-authorized payment. Marketing Fund Contributions are 3% of Gross Sales, also withdrawn weekly; franchisor reserves the right to increase to 4% with 75% franchisee vote approval. Local Advertising Expense is an additional 2% of Gross Sales paid monthly directly by franchisee. POS Help Desk Phone Support Maintenance Service Fee is up to $55/month. Cash Register Service Fees are up to $180/month. Technology Fees are up to $200/month (covers maintenance and POS software upgrades). Security Monitoring Costs are up to $100/month if applicable. Transfer fee is $15,000. Renewal Franchise Fee is 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Relocation Fee is $500. Manager Training/Retraining is $500-$1,500 as incurred. Audit Fee estimated at $2,000-$3,500 (only if understatement of at least 2%). Administrative Fee is 15% of expenses to remedy franchisee default. Renovation/remodeling expense $30,000-$85,000 at least once every 6 years. Gift Card Redemption Fee is currently 11% of gift card redemption amount. Lease Guarantee Fee is 10% of total amount guaranteed up to $10,000 (optional). Late Payment Fee is greater of 5% of unpaid amount or $100 per late payment plus Default Rate interest. Non-participation Fee is $100/day. Late Report Fee is $100 per report per week. NSF Fee is $50 per returned EFT or $25 per returned check.
